# Native web operations

Constructed from the immutable 0.165.0 and 0.167.0 app-server WebSearchAction/ThreadItem schemas checked in under ../../schema. These are protocol-derived fixtures, not a native capture and not DeepSeek HTTP response frames. The first three exercise plural search, openPage and findInPage; the last three are unknown URL, future enum and actual-action query precedence controls. The same native mapper serves every provider of the Responses interface.

The native program supplies no HTTP status or returned page body in these items. The page-read presentation retains its actual URL and keeps those facts unknown; the original action/pattern stays in the raw input. A page operation never becomes a search card. Item counts are not usage counters.
